_comment: Decision tree: routes each turn to the component that handles it. Each node is a CLM readout (head-projected class centroids over the slot-6 embedding of the raw utterance); refs live in models/router_embeddings.npz keyed <node>.<class>, recorded from the serving model by tools/record_router.py — re-record on any serving-numerics change, same rule as decide sigs. Both refs and live text pass norm_router_text (ASR style) or margins collapse. Per the tree-probe experiment (commit 1b72777): no confidence gating — cosine conf is miscalibrated as an error signal. Actions are resolved in web/server.py: llm = direct generation, subtree = walk the named node with the same embedding, tool = tool flow (manifest-JSON generation, validate, execute, confirm; one retry then honest fallback), vision_generic = honesty guard until capture lands. Directives ride the user turn (not the system block) so the frozen prefix stays byte-stable across modes.
